dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Linear trailing edge with zero curvature, forming a straight line segment from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Sharp acute angle at the vertex of the triangular fin geometry with minimal pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear anterior margin at approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width is approximately 1.25 times the vertical height of the fin.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Fragmented convex arc composed of low-polygon flat faces with a wide curvature radius.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered beak with a pixel length roughly 0.6 times the vertical height of the melon inflection.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Visible obtuse interior angle where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum base.

other_distinctive_markers: Low-polygon mesh architecture with visible triangular facets and non-photorealistic teal-to-green gradient texture.
